checks_intro: Cleared checks that everything is in place for a first ticket.
checks_notices: Notes are for information; none prevents a first ticket.
checks_command: The same checks from a terminal, in the clone: docker compose -f v2/compose.yaml run --rm --no-deps service cleared doctor
checks_error_other: The checks could not run. Check again in a moment.
checks_fail_docker: Docker does not answer on this machine.
checks_fail_labels: Docker refuses the label Cleared puts on what it creates.
checks_fail_images: An image the sessions need is missing.
checks_fail_pool: Docker has no free network left for a session.
checks_fail_state: The state folder cannot be written.
checks_fail_settings: The settings file cannot be read.
checks_fail_credentials: A saved connection has the wrong rights.
checks_fail_forge: The token to your code no longer works.
checks_fail_repository: A repository cannot be reached with this token.
checks_fail_checkout: A repository is not on this machine yet.
